Reliable Performance: 5 ATM water resistance, 3 years warranty, and a 30-day return policy – this is a watch you can count on.

watches.name: Zeitgeist Automatik – All Blue
watches.description: German Craftsmanship, Swiss Precision: Designed in Berlin, crafted in Germany, and powered by a Swiss movement, the Zeitgeist Automatic blends fine watchmaking with modern urban aesthetics—an award-winning design honored with the Red Dot Award. The Most Elegant Way to Keep Time: The Sellita SW200 automatic movement requires no battery, drawing energy from the natural motion of your wrist, with a 38-hour power reserve. Timeless Sophistication: A sunburst dial, Superluminova-coated hands and indices, and a 42.5mm case with an integrated crown, complemented by a metal strap—timeless in the best sense. Perfection in Every Detail: The screw-down glass case back reveals the intricate mechanics inside, while the pure sapphire crystal front ensures superior scratch resistance. Lasting Luxury: With 5 ATM water resistance, a 3-year warranty, and a 30-day return policy, this timepiece is built to be relied upon.
